pages.text: 5x5x3: bottom and top layers of $(item)casings$(), the middle layer a ring of $(item)magnet coils$() around an empty 3x3 chamber, the controller in the middle of the front of the ring. $(thing)Right-click the controller$() to assemble it.

To start it, pour in $(thing)water$() (a bucket into any block of the reactor, or a pipe) and feed $(thing)2,000,000 FE$() by cable (ignition). Then the plasma burns on its own: $(thing)8000 FE/t$() for 20 mB of water per tick (deuterium). Without water the plasma goes out and needs a new ignition.
pages.title: Operation
